Name: NPC Vending Machine
Author: ActionJackson22
Description:
No longer worry about what time it is. These machines are always open! But it will cost you an extra 10% to use them. This mod adds NPC Vendors for the following shops:

[list]
[*]Pierre's (seeds and stock)
[*]Marnie's Farm (both animals and goods)
[*]Robin's (buy menu only, no upgrades)
[*]Clint (buy menu only, no upgrades)
[*]Willy
[*]Gus
[/list]
These "vending" machines are placed outside of their corresponding shops, and are overlaid on top of existing game assets. This means if you are using a custom tileset or map replacement this mod SHOULD still work just fine. See the screenshots for placement.

This mod should work with existing saves with no problem.

A special thank you and shout out to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3590100]CherryChain[/url]﻿ and her mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]Shop Tile Framework[/url] whose help on discord and code inspiration helped make this mod possible.
